reviews.title: Better than an in ternal BA flight, tbf
reviews.text: Booked our flight for a resonable price, checked in, flew to Luxor, got our luggage; all good. 5 of us (inc. children) were comfortable, they served snacks and drink although just a 50 min flight. Left and arrived on time. I recommend flying in the morning so you can watch the dessert pan out beneath you and the green of the nile valley all the way to Luxor.
reviews.author: black_labrador

reviews.title: Tourisms and work
reviews.text: Very poor service, too much delay time, i had lost my next transit even though there was 3 hours between time. I dont recommend this to anyone, they will not give any compensation and you could easily be in the same situation as mine!
reviews.author: Ali A

reviews.title: Very bad experience
reviews.text: The worst company I have ever traveled with. At the airport of El Cairo they opened twice my trolley (even if it was well closed) removing all the content and changing the place of many things. The second time, while closing it again, they broke it. At the same airport they didn't want to help me, and they just told me I had to do everything in my country. When I came back, at the airport of Madrid, the Nail Air company told me at the Nile Air counter (where there were more people claiming) that I had to do everything online and, once online, from the official website, they told me they couldn't do anything because I didn't have the document done at the airport of el Cairo, despite the fact they told me that I had to do everything in my home country. Now I have a broken suitcase and I can't do anything. It doesn't seem professional at all, especially the fact that my suitcase was opened without any permission and without my presence.
reviews.author: Gaia

reviews.title: Flight crew member was very poor role model!
reviews.text: On March 9th, 2023 we were on an early morning flight from Cairo to Luxor with other members of our group. We were shocked that a male crew member, in uniform, sat beside us and never once put on his seat belt. The flight attendants seemed to be aware that he wasn't wearing a seat belt but did not say anything to him. When my husband tried to access his tray table in the armrest, the crew member was very reluctant to move his arm as he was too busy playing games on his phone. When we exited the plane, this same male crew member was standing up with the rest of the crew but had not done any work on the flight. The flight was smooth and we were impressed that we received a snack on such a short flight.
reviews.author: B0bNM

reviews.title: Avoid this airline!
reviews.text: We booked flights from Cairo to Luxor and some days before flying they changed the flight to 3 days later! They sent a message asking if that new date suit us, if not if we wanted a refund. We clicked to “yes, we want a refund” and in very small text they explained they would keep 30% of taxes for the refund! Moreover we have not received the money back yet (3 months waiting). Some days later they did the same with our flight from Aswan to Cairo. They make money… without flying. Incredible!
reviews.author: Fileta

reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: The worst airline service ever, my luggage is broken, I spend more than a month to claim the damaged luggage with zero outcome, I have sent all required documents many times, and they keep asking for the same document again and again and again with zero outcome.
reviews.author: Moe H

reviews.title: No notice
reviews.text: The airline changed our flight date and time by 24 hours. We are left to scramble and try to find a flight for our original date and time, no refund or any contact from them. We are just left in the dark with no compensation.
reviews.author: Erika J

reviews.title: good company
reviews.text: that was my first time to fly with this company, but i found it really nice. departed and landed on time without any delay. the seats are comfortable and have enough spaces for the legs
reviews.author: Mohammed K

reviews.title: Tardy Airline. Terrible
reviews.text: The flight was unacceptably LATE. I would not recommend it at all. Very unpleasant and unprofessional
reviews.author: Malebo M

reviews.title: The bad trip ever
reviews.text: It was a bad trip ever in my life , I will not fly on this air line any more Don't fly with this airline ever
reviews.author: Mohamed S

reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: What a terrible experience. They break your luggage to pieces and refuse to compensate claiming that it is mandated in their policy. They have no shame and feel no regret and express no empathy nor do they have the courtesy to extend an apology or just say "we are sorry". I have met rude people before but today I learned the real meaning of shameless rudeness. Don't choose Nile Air because you will be injured and insulted .
reviews.author: Haneen S

reviews.title: A good experience.
reviews.text: Had never heard of Nile Air before my trip to Egypt but ... well... it's called Nile Air. Who doesn't want to fly on an airline called Nile Air? Anyway, booking was easy, the check-in was hassle free and friendly, there were nil issues with baggage etc and everything worked on time. The flight attendants were pleasant and everything just worked.... If I had a criticism to make it would be that the plane interior did look pretty second hand. But outside of that this was a good experience.
reviews.author: Paul L

reviews.title: A good option to use
reviews.text: The trip was smooth without troubles! The airline overall is an average solution to be used. Don't have high expectations in order not to get sad :-D They operate medium size flights (Airbus A320 & A321) flights are pretty old and consumed, but they still fly and not showing any risky issues :-D Our both flights were just on time, both take off & landing! No issues with luggage and no issues with check in The crew on ground and on the flight, were just amazing! Very friendly and make things easy for the family. Positive and willing to help. Their flight time is perfectly matching the normal hotels check in and out times. I liked that a lot. Normal domestic flights services, a light snack, juice & water. presented in a positive attitude. Cannot expect more.
reviews.author: Usama N

reviews.title: Unexpected journey
reviews.text: Thanks to nile air because when I would decided to purchased tickets of nile air I just read the review of this airlines but no good reviews found.But the airlines service was excellent and hospitality also very good,so thanks to nile air and recommended for everybody.
reviews.author: Dr Md Mahbubur

reviews.title: Nothing could be worse than that
reviews.text: Our flight #NP192 was delayed for over 4 hours! No communication nor care from their staff. No compensation for the delay. Horrible experience. We used only since it's the online direct flight from Sabiha airport to Cairo. I wouldn't recommend anyone to use it.
reviews.author: Mohanad Ali

reviews.title: Too many hassles, no support
reviews.text: Flight delays (lack of communication and announcements), issues with check in, no veggie friendly. Overall a non friendly air company - cheap but know what you get into
reviews.author: martinaavilla

reviews.title: Bad service and arrogant stuard and stewardess
reviews.text: The most terrible airline ever. They pack the passengers around 200+ and only open toilets behind, which is only 2 doors, front is reserved for only them.. behind of the airplane got so packed people que for the toilet, toilet it self is terribly smelly, yet they refuse to let the passengers in front toilet. One stuard guarded the toilet as a sphinx guarding the pyramids. Terrible. The meal supposed to be meal for 5.30 hours flight, not a bread and cheese. We paid for the disappointment. Never ever use this airline
reviews.author: Shahlo B

reviews.title: Very dirty
reviews.text: I have travelled a lot of airlines but never was I so disgusted, please don't open seat pockets. They don't clean them it's really gross.
reviews.author: Teja R

reviews.title: Bad experience _ unhelpful staff
reviews.text: They did not postpone or edit my reservation and they mention that booking a flight with booking app is non refundable and non editable. However, the reason of editing my flight is that in the airport at the check in desk, they did a mistake and did not know how to check my e_visa. Check in desk staff was so serious and bothered by the situation. The worst experience ever....
reviews.author: Ranim J

reviews.title: By far the worst airline ever!
reviews.text: These people tend to cancel flights leaving you stranded. They will put you on a flight the next day at double the original charge! They refuse to refund your money so, you have to chargeback through your CC company. STAY AWAY
reviews.author: Rick B

reviews.title: Very poor service
reviews.text: The airline staff are very uneducated and unprofessional what so ever. The service on the airplane is poor and the bathrooms are not clean and they offer very bad food. Worst airline.
reviews.author: Christine Yacoub

reviews.title: The dirtiest airline in the sky
reviews.text: I boomes this airline over others because it was 500 egp cheaper. Big mistake! To begin, they changed the flight time, not by a few hours, but 24 hours earlier causing us to have to book another night at the hotel and change our travel plans. But the worst part was the level of filth in the plane. I went through a whole pack of wet wipes, turning them black with each wipe. There was even food left in the tray. This literally felt like the gas station restroom of airplanes. Luckily it's only an hour flight because I sure as hell don't want to put any food or beverages they might serve into my body. They'll probably serve it on a dirty plate! Ewwwwwwwww...
reviews.author: LonewolfMark

reviews.title: Do NOT fly with Nile Air!
reviews.text: If I could give them 0 stars I would! This is the worst airline that I have ever flown! We had originally booked a flight from Hurghada to Cairo however due to the borders closing we needed to change the flight to leave from Luxor so we could catch our flight back to Australia before the borders closed. When we were trying to change the flight every time by husband rang them they kept telling him that they would call him back in 1 hour but they never did. He kept ringing them and they kept saying one hour. After the third try he said to them that we are Australian citizens and need to return to Cairo to catch our flight to Australia. Their attitude completely changed when they found out we were Australian citizens - they probably realised then that they could get more money out of us! We were charged over 4,000 Egyptian Pounds to change our flight. When I contacted them they said that it was because the seats were premium economy. These seats were definitely not premium economy they were exactly the same as our economy seats that we had on our flight to Aswan. We had no choice but to pay what they were asking as we needed to get back to Cairo to catch our flight to Australia as otherwise we would have been trapped in Egypt. Beware: Do not travel with this airline! Especially if you are a foreigner as they will rip you off and take advantage of you.
reviews.author: Mish x

reviews.title: Cancelled. No warning
reviews.text: Horrible experience. They cancelled the flight without any warning. We were left out without options. No desk, nobody from the airline to give options. We lost our connection to Europe since we had to go with Egypt air the following day. I travel a lot, first time it happens to me
reviews.author: Calamar2011

reviews.title: Beware of this fraudulent company
reviews.text: I bought two tickets directly from their website from Luxor to Cairo and needed to cancel them due issues while travelling. Since they only have one flight in the morning and I needed to fly at afternoon or night, I had to cancel the tickets and get other ones from another company. I fulfilled the form in their website (it's hidden on the FAQ section) and received as response "Kindly accept our sincere apology for not fulfilling your request since your ticket is booked from travel agency and you should refer back to the agency for the refund." There was no travel agency involved on this process and yet they refused to be responsible (an horrible egyptian trait, believe me). When I finally get to the airport I'll try to look for their office and report this.
reviews.author: Cruiser275556

reviews.title: great value for money
reviews.text: i booked couple of flights back and forth on Nile air between Cairo and Luxor during my trip to Egypt in January 2020. both flights were booked last minute and i got a pretty decent deal (800 EGP one way for a flight i booked few hours before flying!) the service both at check in and in-flight were excellent. i was not expecting water or refreshments to be served in flight for free and the cabin crew was extremely pleasant and professional. the flight took off and landed on time both ways and was very clean! i would recommend to anyone!!
reviews.author: Vaani K

reviews.title: Prejudice First Hand
reviews.text: As two American women traveling solo we were astounded to meet Middle Eastern prejudice full on - from the airline flight attendants no less! The flight was fine - we, and all of our luggage - got to Cairo just fine - however we were denied breakfast service on the flight. (Obvious we were not just overlooked but intentionally skipped, especially when we were ignored in trying to get the attendant's attention) Then on debarking not one staff would meet my gaze, they all either looked down, turned away or in the rudest gestures of all, turned their back completely to me. We were not obnoxious or demanding, but quiet, polite and nice and try to get along with most people. And we are grandma's for pity sakes! However, we did not wear the hijab and blue eyes stand out in a culture of brown eyes. This was incredibly rude and unnerving. Egypt is not ready for Western women traveling solo.
reviews.author: catface44

reviews.title: Best Business Class in Egypt
reviews.text: We booked a flight from Luxor to Cairo because the time was right... We’d flown Egypt Air in business class and they were just regular coach seats with the middle seat blocked off...so not that special. We figured we were probably in for more of the same on Nile Air. So imagine our surprise when boarding Nile Air—an airline we’d never heard of—to find plush, comfy leather seats—a true business class! We’d fly them again in a heartbeat!!
reviews.author: dxlake

reviews.title: NO PROBLEM WITH OUR FLIGHT
reviews.text: I booked this flight with edream and everything went fine. Check in in advance was not possible. Flights are quite early in the morning... Sandwich and soft drink are served on board. It is very important to know your terminal in advance since the airport is big The national flight section at the airport lacks information and it was not easy to find our check in desk.... Several domestic flights are leaving from the same area at similar times so make sure that you are lining up at the right place
reviews.author: Anne S

reviews.title: Space are incredibly small
reviews.text: I was 174 cm, 73 mg a male of average size. Flying with nile air was my first time and will be the last time as the space was terribly small. I could not sit with my legs straight. We should ask the CEO of the Nile air to sit on the seat himself!!!.
reviews.author: King kong

reviews.title: The worst airline company ever
reviews.text: I don't recommend this airline. They lost my luggage which I never gotten back even I contacted them many time each time they lie to me. The plane was very uncomfortable and crammed. The food sucks they gave us very cheap sandwiches with cheese. It was the worst experience I have ever had. I will never ever use Nile Air
reviews.author: Adam H

reviews.title: Egypt, Cairo
reviews.text: I really enjoyed it with a welcome crew and a nice box of breakfast , Great and the most cheapest one
reviews.author: Amira Refaat

reviews.title: Very good flight
reviews.text: Nile Air was a much cheaper option for return flights from Istanbul to Cairo.The flights were on time .Check in was easy.They give you nice free meal on a 2 hour flight this was a surprise.They Also give you 20kg free baggage .Great value for money flight
reviews.author: COTTONEYEDDJ

reviews.title: Rather not
reviews.text: This was an internal flight in Egypt, and getting through to check in on it's own was a mission! The plane was not that clean, and in particular the tray tables on which meals are served which puts you off.
reviews.author: Bilal

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: I wanted a flight from Cairo to Luxor to catch a Nile Cruise then from Aswan back to Cairo. I was a bit hesitant about using a new airline but reserved it anyway. The price was much cheaper than Egyptair but the service was no less excellent. For short trips inside Egypt I recommend this company. They were on time and presented great food and service.
reviews.author: Moataz Emam

reviews.title: Smooth flight
reviews.text: I had a good experience with Nile air - very friendly check-in service, and a fine flight with no hassles. I will happily use the carrier again
reviews.author: Albri S

reviews.title: Nice and clean
reviews.text: Very organized company, flights are clean, bit small but generally fine. Meals are good, flights take off and landed on time, flight crew are polite. Recommend for domestic flights.
reviews.author: Yasmin E

reviews.title: not bad for the price
reviews.text: old plane but not bad....staff is friendly and I was surprised any airline still offer food (not good) on a 45 minutes flight.
reviews.author: Dalia R

reviews.title: Great service at a decent price
reviews.text: We flew Nile Air from Luxor to Cairo. A good airline no frills but safe and comfortable. Definitely worth using for a safe way to travel domestically.
reviews.author: Alice Ball

reviews.title: Did not have options
reviews.text: Very old airplane.seats are dirty and ripped. Did not sound like well maintained. Took off and landed on time. Great pilot.
reviews.author: Sherif S

reviews.title: BAD AIRLINE
reviews.text: من اسوء خطوط الطيران في العالم واسوء موظفين علي الاطلاق The worst airline ever and specially the crew they treat people like stupid and they are very very rude i will never ever book any of my flights again
reviews.author: anahaidy

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: I travelled more than 6 times with Nile air as it is cheaper than other airlines. When I bought my ticket for the first time I was so afraid because I didn't know about them. But then they became like my family as I I travel with them at least twice a year. Their foods are good, their cabin crew are nice. They don't make problem if your luggage is heavier a few kg more. They accepted my bags although they were 5 kg more. Till now they were late only once. And last June I had a ticket, but 3 days before my flight, my brother passed away. I asked refund, they sent me an e-mail, consoled for my loss, and refunded all of my money back. They are so kind and lovely. So I highly recommend this airline.
reviews.author: Beyza

reviews.title: Good flight, poor cleanliness
reviews.text: Customer service was fine. Was only 1 hr flight and snacks were ok. However, the plane was dirty. Tray had coffee stains and they might clean the plan windows for better tourist experience since flying over such unique landscape. Other wise it was an uneventful flight.
reviews.author: NC2264

reviews.title: Very good flight
reviews.text: Checkin is very good Timing is very good Luggage handling is very good Cleanliness is very good Seat size is good
reviews.author: Mohamad A

reviews.title: Great Airline
reviews.text: Great Airline ! New Airplanes ! Always on time ! Great Crew! Easy checking in Everyone at Nile Air were very professional, kind and pleasant It was a safe and comfortable. I highly recommend this airlines to all the people that would love to go to Luxor . Loved Nile Air
reviews.author: DIanna Q

reviews.title: Poor cleanliness
reviews.text: Everything was fine: price, booking process, boarding, landed even earlier than scheduled, the crew was lovely. They even offered us snacks for such a short flight. Our only complain is that the aircraft was super dirty! The seats had very obvious stains, there was food crumbs in between the cushions and I don’t even wanna talk about the tray table, so stinky!
reviews.author: Ioanna

reviews.title: Egypt"s Budget Airline needs an upgrade
reviews.text: Nile Air is at best a glorified air taxi...just adequate to get one around the major cities and tourist destinations in Egypt. The Airbus 320 are in need of upgrade in livery and maintenance and may not be an airline of choice for someone who is looking for safe travel. The fare dire emcee between the national carrier Egypt Air is approx 25% less in economy.
reviews.author: MaestroUno1

reviews.title: needs improving ,horrible meal
reviews.text: the flight was short anyway ,but few notes here ,the check in counter is right by the boarding gate so once you passed security to the check in counter you can not leave the boarding hall , staff on the plan does not smile nor make you feel welcome they seem to be on auto pilot mode , take off was very smooth I can say it was the best take off i ever had , was very strange the plane was ready to take off 15 minutes early ,meal serves on the plane was horrible ,the plane seats are old but in good condition
reviews.author: Amgad Abbas

reviews.title: Good flight
reviews.text: It’s my first time travel with Nile airways, surprisingly the ground team was professional,the aircraft is new and clean. Good service
reviews.author: Dr. Amr hamdy

reviews.title: Paying same price as in Egypt Air but for less quality of service
reviews.text: Paying the same price as in Egypt Air but for less quality of service. Comparing to the flight back from Aswan to Cairo with Egypt Air, Nile Air charged the same amount of money but offered less than Egypt Air.
reviews.author: TareqAbdalla
